summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Perrette Pradier, a French actress who lived from 17 April 1938 to 16 January 2013. She is best known for voice acting, a specialty that earned her the nicknames "Queen" or "High Priestess" of dubbing.
one_line: Perrette Pradier was a French actress (1938–2013) famed as a voice actress nicknamed the "Queen" of dubbing.
key_facts: Perrette Pradier was born on 17 April 1938.
Perrette Pradier was a French actress.
Perrette Pradier is best known for her work as a voice actress.
Her voice acting work earned Perrette Pradier the nickname "Queen" of dubbing.
Her voice acting work also earned Perrette Pradier the nickname "High Priestess" of dubbing.
